answer: An island reaches summit only after serving judged epochs on its own key, burning one ocean per epoch; the kth live island must serve k epochs. Ocean is non-transferable and minted only by judging others, so a farm cannot pool, buy, or split it: the thousandth fake needs 1,000 epochs, and a batch of 1,000 burns at least 500,500 ocean. The bill is ocean per judged epoch plus elapsed attested epochs, attached to each island at summit registration. It fails if ocean transfers or judged epochs can be outsourced.
